observations.says: from four o'clock on Saturday until eight o'clock on Saturday, the passage door of the garden room was shut
from four o'clock on Saturday until dusk on Saturday, the terrace door of the garden room was shut
from dusk on Saturday until eight o'clock on Saturday, Mr. Farrant was in the passage
from dusk on Saturday until eight o'clock on Saturday, Philip Wray was not in the passage
from five o'clock on Saturday until dusk on Saturday, Mr. Farrant was on the terrace
from four o'clock on Saturday until dusk on Saturday, Philip Wray was in the passage
from dusk on Saturday until eight o'clock on Saturday, Dunn was not on the terrace
